label: D2: chose a2 but landed in S1 (rare a2 transition), early-to-mid episode
explanation: Fires only at D2 (never at D1 or GO). The large activations (top two quartiles, ~91% of activation mass) occur when the agent chose a2 and the observed state is S1, i.e. a rare a2->S1 transition; activations there are 0.6-1.0 of max. A smaller set of high activations occur on a1->S1 common steps that follow a2 choices (agent switched to a1). The low-magnitude tail (bottom two quartiles, ~9% of mass) is a weak ~0.05-0.15 firing on ordinary a2->S2 common D2 steps, mostly after rewarded trials; this is what limits recall. The unit fades with episode time: it is most active in trials 10-30 and is silent after trial ~80, so restricting to ep_trial < 70 raises precision from 0.61 to 0.87 (dev). Without the time term, D2 & in_state==1 & in_action==2 gives dev F1 0.59, mass recall 0.91. Not active on in_rew==1 steps, on D1/GO, or on S2-reached a1 trials. Uses only inputs observable at D2 (the reached state and the just-made choice) plus episode time.
